C08-M06-L03-F1.title: An intelligence-driven enrichment pipeline
C08-M06-L03-F1.caption: Entities are canonicalised and gated before any lookup, external values walk a cascade of sources from cheapest and most private to most exposed, and every answer is recorded with its provenance.
C08-M06-L03-F1.alt: Graph, top to bottom. Entities from alerts (588 values from normalised fields) leads to Canonicalise + dedupe (20 distinct values, placeholder dropped), which leads to Classify + privacy gate. The gate branches to Internal sources only (CMDB, identity, history) and to a cascade for external values: 1 Allowlists / warning lists, then 2 Cache, then 3 Internal TIP + ISAC data, then 4 Approved external service. Each cascade box and the internal branch lead to Record with provenance (source, time, as-of, marking, cache or live), which leads to Attach to alert + feed back.

nodes.label: Record with provenance
nodes.sub: source, time, as-of, marking, cache or live

C08-M06-L03-F1.note: No value reaches a source before the gate has decided it may go there.

C08-M06-L03-F2.title: One lookup through the cache and a rate-limited source
C08-M06-L03-F2.caption: A cache miss, a negative answer from the internal platform, a 429 refusal with Retry-After, a backed-off retry and a cached, provenance-tagged result.
C08-M06-L03-F2.alt: Sequence diagram with four lanes: Pipeline worker, Cache, Internal TIP, External service. Worker asks Cache for the value and source; Cache replies miss. Worker queries Internal TIP; TIP replies no data, recorded with time. Worker queries External service for the canonical external domain; service replies 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After. Worker waits and backs off, then retries the same request; service replies verdict + source details. Worker stores the result in Cache with a type-specific TTL and provenance.

messages.label: store: result, TTL by type, provenance

C08-M06-L03-F2.note: A refusal changes the worker's timing; a timeout is recorded as unavailable, never as clean.
